name: jev-vercel-sandbox
description: Runs dangerous Bash commands in a Vercel Sandbox instead of on your machine. TypeSafe's Jev judges every command Claude is about to run (destructive, remote code, a change to the machine, data leaving it); one past the threshold runs in an isolated Linux microVM started with the session, and its output comes back as the Bash result with a note telling Claude where it ran. A side pane shows the sandbox is ready and what ran there. Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier when no Jev key is set. Needs function hooks (early access).

vercelToken.title: Vercel token
vercelToken.description: A Vercel access token (vercel.com/account/tokens), or an OIDC token from `vercel env pull`. Empty: the VERCEL_TOKEN, then VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN environment variable

vercelTeamId.title: Vercel team id
vercelTeamId.description: The team (team_…) the sandbox is billed to; needed with an access token, read from an OIDC token. Empty: VERCEL_TEAM_ID

vercelProjectId.title: Vercel project id
vercelProjectId.description: The project (prj_…) the sandbox belongs to; needed with an access token, read from an OIDC token. Empty: VERCEL_PROJECT_ID

sandboxImage.title: Sandbox image
sandboxImage.description: Image to start from; empty uses Vercel's default (vercel/sandbox/universal: Ubuntu, Node.js LTS, Python)

sandboxVcpus.title: vCPUs
sandboxVcpus.description: vCPUs for the sandbox; leave unset for Vercel's default

sandboxTimeoutMinutes.title: Sandbox lifetime (minutes)
sandboxTimeoutMinutes.description: How long the sandbox lives before Vercel stops it; the next dangerous command after that starts a new one. Your plan caps it

persistent.title: Persistent sandbox
persistent.description: Keep the sandbox's filesystem when it stops (Vercel snapshots it). Off: every session starts clean

startOnSessionStart.title: Start with the session
startOnSessionStart.description: Start the sandbox when the session starts; off starts it on the first dangerous command

stopOnExit.title: Stop on exit
stopOnExit.description: Stop the sandbox when the session ends

commandTimeoutMs.title: Command timeout (ms)
commandTimeoutMs.description: Longest a sandboxed command may run when Claude sets no timeout of its own (max 600000)

whenUnavailable.title: When the sandbox is unavailable
whenUnavailable.description: "deny" refuses a dangerous command the sandbox cannot run (not configured, failed to start); "local" runs it on this machine as if the mod were not there

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai, the judge (calibrated probabilities). Empty: the Gateway key, else the built-in classifier

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway key
gatewayApiKey.description: Reaches Jev through ai-gateway.vercel.sh when no TypeSafe key is set

provider.title: Judge backend
provider.description: "auto" picks TypeSafe when its key is set, then the Gateway, then the built-in classifier

threshold.title: Sandbox threshold
threshold.description: A hazard probability at or above this sends the command to the sandbox

severityThreshold.title: Severity threshold
severityThreshold.description: A severity score (0-3) at or above this sends the command to the sandbox whatever the probabilities

judgeTimeoutMs.title: Judge latency budget (ms)
judgeTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Jev before applying onJudgeError

onJudgeError.title: When the judge fails
onJudgeError.description: Where a command goes when the judge gives no answer (timeout, error)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "enforce" sandboxes dangerous commands; "audit" only logs what it would sandbox and runs everything locally

openPanel.title: Open the side pane
openPanel.description: Open the sandbox pane when the session starts; the engine keeps an unasked pane hidden below 144 columns (/jev-vercel-sandbox opens it)

columns.title: Pane width
columns.description: Columns asked for the docked pane in the fullscreen layout (28-80)

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each judgement and where the command ran to the session log
